learning_outcomes.text: Students master various key qualifications complementing their studies or have deepened their subject knowledge, according to their choice.

syllabus_topics: Students must complete courses totaling at least 8 CP. Through the free choice of courses from the entire offering of RUB, UARuhr, and UNIC, students can set disciplinary and interdisciplinary focuses according to their own interests. Different content is taught depending on the course selection.
assessment_rules: Grading is unweighted for the final grade. One exam must be taken in each free elective module.
